purpose: Freeze candidate-independent E0 state/storage discrepancy thresholds for the three prospectively selected common 36-material state anchors before any new material-extension RossFast discrepancy is executed.

matrix.materials: all 36 D3R materials B01-B18 and O01-O18

reference_only_method.comparison: one Reference solve over 0.0064 day versus two sequential Reference solves over 0.0032 + 0.0032 day

frozen_threshold_rule.statistic: maximum Reference self-disagreement across all 72 valid cases in exact Se stratum

outcome_policy.if_all_216_reference_pairs_valid: Persist exactly fifteen frozen thresholds, five metrics x three Se strata. The next workunit may preregister new RossFast extension discrepancies.
outcome_policy.if_any_reference_pair_invalid: Do not freeze thresholds and do not execute RossFast. Persist the negative Reference-domain result.

future_candidate_evidence_boundary.primary_new_holdout: 30 extension materials B02-B11,B13-B18,O02-O04,O06-O13,O15-O17 at Se={0.65,0.85,0.96} and DRYING/NOMINAL
future_candidate_evidence_boundary.anchor_role: The six original P2E10 materials may be rerun for continuity, but their previously observed Se=0.65/0.85 behavior is not relabelled as untouched holdout evidence.
future_candidate_evidence_boundary.wetting: Remains excluded under current RossFast production forcing envelope unless separately qualified.
